title: Terminal Jumps Unexpectedly To the Beginning Of The Conversation During Input with Long Buffer
body:
**Bug Description**
Sometimes (especially with long conversation history in the terminal buffer, when I start typing or run a command from the input field, claude jumps to the start of the buffer and scrolls until the end - it's like the effect of catting a very large file in the terminal and watching the terminal scanning through the entire file until the end - extermely annoying. Not sure if this is relevant but I'm using claude inside a tmux session running in kitty terminal emulator.

**Environment Info**
- Platform: macos
- Terminal: tmux
- Version: 0.2.100
- Feedback ID: 0f659b0e-4fc7-474f-88db-fbf830fbc334
